    for name in filenames:
        if not name.endswith('.py'):
            continue

                src = f.read()

                if tok.type == tokenize.COMMENT and 'TODO' in tok.string:
                    hits.add((rel, tok.start[0]))
        except (SyntaxError, tokenize.TokenError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
            print('skipped: ' + rel)

lines = [f'{p}:{n}' for p, n in sorted(hits)]
with open(os.path.join(root, 'todos.txt'), 'w') as out:
    out.write('\n'.join(lines) + ('\n' if lines else ''))
print('\n'.join(lines))
